content.what_it_is: Interactive MATLAB postprocessor for a rip-current case. It loads bathymetry and creates a 1 m by 2 m plotting mesh (L3-L10), asks for an output-index range (L16-L17), then per index loads mean velocities, elevation, and mask and masks dry cells (L22-L35). It renders elevation, velocity curl, and signed-depth/quiver panels with fixed axes and pauses between frames (L37-L91).
unresolved: `dep` is loaded once before the frame loop at L5, then destructively set to NaN under each frame's mask at L33. A cell dry in any early frame remains NaN in all later frames even if it becomes wet, so the depth panel accumulates the union of historical dry masks rather than showing the current mask.
The two caxis calls for the depth subplot conflict: L75 sets [-12,0], then L80 overwrites it with [-12,2.5] on the same axes without intervening axes selection.
The file does not validate that u, v, eta, mask, and dep dimensions agree before shared masking/curl operations (L27-L57).
`w_ang` and `icount` are calculated but never used (L21-L24,L57). Interactive nstart/nend are unvalidated, so reversed or nonexistent output ranges yield no plots or load failures.
